title: Artificial Intelligence in Mechanical Engineering: Foundations, Opportunities, Challenges, and Responsibilities
abstract: arXiv:2610.33105v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping mechanical engineering (ME), from modeling, simulation, and optimization to diagnostics, design, and technical communication. Drawing on a round-table at the 28th ABCM International Congress on Mechanical Engineering (COBEM 2025), this article presents a structured perspective for the Brazilian and international ME communities. Rather than an exhaustive survey, it examines how AI can enhance engineering practice without compromising scientific rigor. We distinguish statistical learning from human cognition and discuss the capabilities, limitations, and emerging agentic forms of AI. We then consider industrial adoption, workforce changes, and AI-assisted scientific discovery, alongside the energy and infrastructure demands of AI computation and their implications for sustainability and thermal management. translated_title: 机械工程中的人工智能：基础、机遇、挑战与责任
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）正在重塑机械工程（ME），涵盖建模、仿真、优化、诊断、设计以及技术交流等领域。本文基于第28届ABCM国际机械工程大会（COBEM 2025）的一次圆桌讨论，为巴西及国际机械工程界提供了一个结构化的视角。本文并非详尽的综述，而是探讨AI如何在不损害科学严谨性的前提下增强工程实践。我们区分了统计学习与人类认知，并讨论了AI的能力、局限性以及新兴的智能体（agentic）形态。随后，我们探讨了工业界的采纳情况、劳动力的变化以及AI辅助的科学发现，同时还分析了AI计算对能源和基础设施的需求及其对可持续性和热管理的影响。讨论强调物理知识、结构化推理等方面的融合。
tldr: 本文基于COBEM 2025圆桌讨论，为机械工程界提供了应用AI的结构化视角，强调在不牺牲科学严谨性的前提下融合物理知识与结构化推理，以增强工程实践并应对AI的能力局限、能源需求与责任挑战。
en_tdlr: Drawing on a COBEM 2025 round-table, this article offers a structured perspective on how AI can enhance mechanical engineering practice without compromising scientific rigor, emphasizing the integration of physical knowledge and structured reasoning to address AI's capabilities, limitations, energy demands, and responsibilities.
